subject: Schedule change from SAS - Booking reference TESTRF
body:
Important information about your SAS booking TESTRF

Unfortunately, we've had to change our flight schedule which has impacted your trip with booking reference TESTRF.

Please see our suggested new itinerary in My bookings.

We apologize for any inconvenience and hope that the new flight(s) will suit you.

You now have three options:

Travel on the new flight(s) we provide as an alternative

Rebook to a new flight, free of charge. See My bookings for your alternatives under comparable transport conditions. We kindly ask you to do this within 15 days after receiving this message.

Cancel your booking. We'll process your refund within seven days, for the part or parts of the journey not traveled. Please submit your refund request in My bookings.

You can read more about your rights here: EU Passenger Rights | SAS (flysas.com)

We look forward to welcoming you on board.

SAS
